```markdown
# Arc 04 dogfood — the Ralph loop

**You are the loop's orchestrator, and you hold nothing.** Each iteration re-reads this file.
Your context is the cost: every line you read that a sub-agent could have read is a line the
loop carries to its end. You pick, dispatch, check, stop. You never implement.

## 1 What you read

| | |
|---|---|
| This file | Every iteration |
| The queue | `gh issue list --label workstream --milestone Dogfood`, then the parent's sub-issues |
| Nothing else | Not the issue plan, not the arc-log, not the code |

## 2 One iteration

| | |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Pick.** First open `Agent`-typed sub-issue of the workstream parent whose `Blocked by` issues are all closed. Arc-log §3.1 rules; do not re-derive them |
| 2 | **Dispatch one sub-agent, fresh context.** It receives `run-instructions.md` and the issue body, nothing from you. It runs the issue start to finish — branch, checklist, gate, passes, dev-log, PR, merge |
| 3 | **Check, do not read.** `gh pr view` — merged, closing keyword bound, label removed. Three `gh` reads, no file opens |
| 4 | **Record one line** in the arc-log status table: issue, PR, merged or not |
| 5 | End the turn. The Stop hook re-feeds this file |

## 3 Stop

Output the completion promise, `ARC WORKSTREAM DONE`, when:

| | |
|---|---|
| No open children of any type | Dispatch the report run first, §6 of `run-instructions.md` |
| A human-typed issue is next | Say which and stop. Not yours |
| A sub-agent returned blocked | Say why. Do not retry, do not pick the next |
| Max iterations reached | The hook stops you. Say where the queue stands |

## 4 Never

| | |
|---|---|
| Implement | A sub-agent that edits is fine; you editing is the context blow-up |
| Read a changed file | Pass 4 is the sub-agent's. You read `gh`, not the tree |
| Pick two | One issue per iteration |
| Raise the mode | `HANDOFF.md` says autonomous or the sub-agent's commit is denied. You never write that row |
```
